notes: Address-only slice of Customers, decided via the AI mapping agent (see etl/agent/mapping_decisions.csv for the full back-and-forth, including the rejected COUNTRY = legacy Country column option). The rest of Customers (Customer_Name, Email, Tax_ID, etc. -> BUT000/KNVV fields) has not been through that process yet and is intentionally NOT covered here -- see sap_target_schema/legacy_to_sap_mapping.csv for the table-level routing (Customers -> MIGRATE -> BUT000 + Customer role).

targets.notes: Shipping address -> odd-numbered ADDRNUMBER series, disjoint from billing by construction.

dropped_fields.reason: Investigated before mapping: disagrees with the address-parsed city on 20/40 billing rows (50%) and 21/40 shipping rows (52.5%). Currency (100% JOD) and Phone_Number country code (100% +962) are constant across all 40 rows regardless of stated Country, so they can't corroborate it either way. Tax_ID (checked as a follow-up) is also uninformative -- 9-digit values with no prefix pattern separating Jordan-city rows from Gulf-city rows. 6 of 9 customers with 'Jordan' literally in the company name have a non-Jordan Country value (e.g. 'Jordan Ahli Bank' -> Country=UAE). Conclusion: Country is uncorrelated noise, not a reliable signal; ADRC-COUNTRY is derived from the address-parsed city instead (see the COUNTRY fields above), which is drawn from a small, real, internally consistent set of actual city names. Full investigation and agent conversation: etl/agent/mapping_decisions.csv.
